info.title: ProbeHive API
info.description: Contract-compatible API for ProbeHive organization bootstrap, local authentication, Monitors, immutable revisions, Runs, and Observations.

head.summary: Report process liveness without a body
Report PostgreSQL readiness without a body

get.summary: Return this OpenAPI document in Development
Report whether the first administrator exists

post.summary: Create the first administrator and provision the installation Organization
post.description: Creates the first administrator, provisions the installation Organization with slug 'default' and its default Project through the idempotent provisioning use case, then issues a session cookie. A new installation is usable without a separate Organization step.

201.description: The first administrator and the installation Organization were created and a session cookie was issued.

get.summary: Issue or rotate a synchronizer antiforgery token

200.description: The request token and required header name. A host-only antiforgery cookie is also set.

post.summary: Authenticate a local user and issue a session

200.description: The authenticated user. A fresh session cookie is also set.

204.description: The session was invalidated and its cookie expired.

get.summary: List Organizations with their default Projects
get.description: Requires any authenticated session. Returns the caller's Organization memberships in creation order with the Organization id as a tie-breaker, and a bare empty array when none exist.

200.description: The Organizations visible to the caller.

post.summary: Idempotently provision an Organization and default Project
post.description: Requires the instance Administrator role. The creator becomes the new Organization's Administrator member in the same transaction. A matching slug and display name replays with 200 and writes no membership; a new Organization returns 201.

201.description: The Organization and default Project were created.

put.description: Requires the organization.write permission. The slug is immutable because it is the idempotency key for provisioning; after a rename, provisioning the same slug with the pre-rename display name conflicts and the current name replays.

get.summary: Return an Organization and its default Project

put.summary: Apply a valid Monitor state transition
Change how often a Monitor is due
put.description: Requires an Administrator session. Changing the interval appends no revision: a revision snapshots check configuration, and scheduling frequency is not check configuration.

get.summary: List immutable revisions in ascending number order

post.summary: Validate and append the next immutable revision

get.description: Requires monitor.read. Returns a bounded newest-first keyset page ordered by scheduledFor and Run id. notBefore is required so PostgreSQL can prune retained monthly partitions. nextCursor is null on the final page and otherwise must be sent back unchanged with the same filters.
Requires monitor.read. The lease holder is never exposed. A real Run identifier under the wrong Organization, Project, or Monitor returns 404.
Requires monitor.read. In-flight and skipped Runs have no Observation and return 404. The response contains only the bounded codes, timings, and protocol details persisted under ADR 0024.

sessionCookie.name: probehive.session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque server-side session token. Only its SHA-256 hash is persisted.

antiforgeryCookie.name: probehive.antiforgery
antiforgeryCookie.description: Host-only selector cookie issued by the antiforgery endpoint.

antiforgeryHeader.name: X-ProbeHive-Antiforgery
antiforgeryHeader.description: Synchronizer request token returned by the antiforgery endpoint.

RunNotBefore.name: notBefore
RunNotBefore.description: Inclusive lower scheduledFor bound. Exactly one RFC 3339 timestamp is required.

RunCursor.name: cursor
RunCursor.description: Opaque nextCursor returned by the preceding page.

RunOutcome.name: outcome
RunOutcome.description: Optional exact outcome filter. In-flight Runs have no outcome and are included only when this filter is absent.

RunLocation.name: location
RunLocation.description: Optional exact Probe Location identifier, bounded to 63 UTF-8 bytes.

Location.description: Canonical relative URI of the created resource.

BadRequest.description: Malformed input, validation failure, or invalid antiforgery state.

Forbidden.description: The principal lacks the required role or the browser origin was rejected.

Run.description: The fully scoped Run without its lease-holder token.

NotFound.description: The route or fully scoped resource was not found.

Conflict.description: The requested operation conflicts with current or concurrently updated state.

TooManyRequests.description: The per-client credential-attempt limit was exhausted.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The route does not allow this method.

ValidationError.description: One field-level failure. 'code' is the stable contract identifier clients localize from; 'message' is current English documentation and may be reworded without a compatibility event.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details. Prose is always English; clients localize from 'code' and from the 'code' of each validation error.

code.description: Stable identifier for a non-validation problem. Absent on validation problems, where each entry of 'errors' carries its own code.

RunResponse.description: A Run without its secret lease-holder token. Nullable state fields distinguish in-flight, completed, and skipped Runs.

ObservationResponse.description: Bounded persisted execution detail. It contains no target-supplied headers, body, message, or lease-holder token.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL without user information or a fragment; length is measured in UTF-16 code units.

headers.description: Header names must be unique using ASCII case-insensitive comparison.

name.description: HTTP token excluding Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie, Host, Content-Length, and Transfer-Encoding using ASCII case-insensitive comparison.

value.description: Value without Unicode control characters; length is measured in UTF-16 code units.
